sections.title: Clear: bloodrush
sections.subtitle: Bloodrush with healer and mage, then clear rooms
lines: In the clear your first job is to bloodrush with the healer and the mage.
For perfect br waypoints, download ADM and turn on the bloodrush waypoints module.
Once you finish br, backtrack until fairy and take a split.
The healer should cut the mages secrets appropriately and then leap out or follow you.
Your priority is clearing rooms, as that is what archer does best.
Sometimes you pull small splits, so keep checking your map and know which teammates are struggling most with their splits so you can leap effectively.
Example: if your bers has the entire map on him and fairy opens into a 2 room split, midclear both rooms then leap to bers so you eliminate all backtracking.

sections.title: Maxor: left crystal
sections.subtitle: Spring boots, left crystal, leap tank, arrowstack
lines: Swap to your spring boots and grab the left crystal, then leap to the tank.
Spring boot back up and leap to the tank again.
Swap back to your necron and arrowstack Maxor.
During Maxor's death animation swap in your rag, deathbow, and ice spray.
Leap to the Bers for storm.
After your arrow finally stops bouncing put your Necron back on and clear the belt, then dps Maxor.
Try not to instantly enrage since your tank will take a lot of damage from the withers.
Make sure the wither skeletons are dead before you enrage Maxor.
Enrage at 18-19s for the fastest possible kill.

sections.title: Storm: rag, stack, kill
sections.subtitle: Arrowstack at 32.5 (34.4 if 100 ping)
lines: Attempt to use your rag swapping to your ender dragon when it casts or if it is cancelled.
Ice spray a group of mobs then pull back your death bow and fire.
Sword swap to your ice spray wand and armor swap to your monster raider.
When your arrow stops bouncing, put your Necron's armor back on.
If you are high ping, hit your loadout open hotkey and then swap to your ice spray wand, as there is so much delay that it is the fastest method.
Quickly clear the mobs between the purple and red pillars.
Then clear the archers to the side and all around the central area.
Then clear the red/green side archers, and finally clear the red pad.
Stand under purple for Storm's lightning.
Start your rag axe at 26.5 and click a keybind to get 2 twilight arrow poison's from your sacks (use /dv keyshortcuts to set /gfs Twilight_Arrow_Poison 2 on a keybind).
Ult and pull back your last breath when the rag pops.
Release the lb and begin your arrowstack at 32.5 (if you are 100 ping, 34.4).
Do not instantly swap to your term if you are over 100 ping, as it will void your last breath ability.
When you swap to your term spam left click to avoid getting the bow pullback animation.
When storm enrages leap to the mage and stand at the back of yellow.
Arrowstack at 37.5 to get a fast yellow kill.

sections.title: S1: 4 then 3
sections.subtitle: Leap healer, setswap terms, 4 then 3
lines: Arch's role in terms is: 43 / 4 rl / 4 bl / 2.
When Storm is over leap to the healer and setswap to your terms set, then move to 4.
After you do 4 drop down to 3.
If your tank gets a melody on 2, leap to them and stack 1.
If they did not or if they have a melody on 1, just leap to the mage when the section finishes.

sections.title: S2: hold W, do 4
sections.subtitle: Hold W, no jump, do 4, bonzo, right lever
lines: Hold W and do not jump and you will drop down to 4.
Complete 4 and then walk to your right and bonzo off the near wall.
Flick the right lever.
Then leap to your healer who will be at ee3.
You should have all your masks so you won't die preleaping.

sections.title: S3: premove to 4
sections.subtitle: Finish term 4 fast, section is on your levers time
lines: Premove to 4 and try to complete your terminal as fast as possible as the section is based off your levers time.
Do the movement as shown if you can.
If you finish your term and the tank has already leaped to get levers, preleap to s4 and premove.

sections.title: S4: leap mage, term
sections.subtitle: Term fast, leap mage for core, Necron armor on
lines: Leap to the mage and run to your term as fast as possible.
Then leap to the mage for core and put your necron armor back on.
Rag if you have time.

sections.title: Goldor: run out, fire
sections.subtitle: Run out and fire ASAP; rag before Necron
lines: When the Goldor phase starts, run out as fast as possible and try to fire as soon as possible.
If you did not Rag for Goldor, Rag before Necron starts.

sections.title: Necron: rag, bonemarang
sections.subtitle: Rag, ender dragon, blade, bonemarang, Gdrag
lines: Use your rag axe quickly if you didn't in Goldor.
Leap to the mage when you drop and stand with them.
When the 70m health fire phase starts, use your rag and then swap to your ender dragon.
Hit necron with your adaptive blade then bonemarang Necron.
Swap to monster raider + Gdrag before it comes back.
This is to get a better rapid fire ability for dragons.

sections.title: Relics: 650 speed
sections.subtitle: Racing helmet + black cat, premove, flick 180
lines: Swap to racing helmet (or 4/4 young dragon armor) with your black cat to get 650 speed.
Begin holding S and spamming right click with .2 left to spawn on your relic to hit a successful premove.
Flick 180 degrees when you see the relic spawn and place it in the cauldron.
The anvil occasionally bugs and red relic time doesn't matter much.
You need to be fast for a fast green relic.
Alternative method (easier): swap to black cat and a cow hat, and spam click.
Hold s, flick and hold w when you see the relic spawn.

sections.title: Dragons: rag and stack
sections.subtitle: Run to stack spot at 1000-1200 ms left to spawn
lines: Stand middle after placing your relic.
Swap in your rogue sword, tuba, and sword of bad health.
Use your rag axe on the wither kings 2nd dialogue ("I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you").
Then use the rest of your buffs on yourself and run to the stack spot for your split dragon.
Start running towards the dragon at around 1000 ms left to spawn.
After split, clear the husks mid or under already killed dragons.
Use your rag axe again as it comes off cooldown and go to the stack spot for dragon 3.
For non split dragons begin running at 1000-1200 ms (the higher the power the closer to 1200).
This is to "fast stack", which is better dps for a short burst however worse over a course of 2 seconds.
Use your ult with 2200ms until dragon 4 spawns and continue to stack like normal.
